briefdescription.para: Integration tests for Grammar class (Q1 robustness work).

detaileddescription.para: These tests exercise the Grammar constructors without a real llama_model so they can run in any CI environment. They validate:

listitem.para: Empty EBNF / empty start-symbol → isValid() == false with descriptive error.
Null model in the model-aware constructor → hard error (not silent fallback).
Valid EBNF text is stored correctly even when compilation fails because the llama API is absent in the test environment.
